verdict.rationale: YYLO orchestrates external coding agents and lets you pick the subagent (`--subagent claude`, `yy pi`). Its site says it delegates work 'across agents and models', and benchmarks bind 'model selectors', so agents can run on a model of your choice. However, nothing documents supplying your own API key or configuring arbitrary LLM providers or endpoints. missing for 10: documented bring-your-own API key configuration, a list of supported model providers, per-agent model selection docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can bring my own LLM or API key so agents run on the model of my choice

citations.quote: Delegate bounded work across agents and models.
yylo init --task "Describe one verifiable outcome" --subagent claude
Bind cases, model selectors, attempts and evaluator configuration before execution.
